_readme: DORMANT PROOF SLOTS. Every array below is empty on purpose.
The site has no operating history, no reviews and no certifications on file, so none are claimed anywhere.
The components that read this file return null on an empty array — no empty section, no heading with nothing
under it, no 'coming soon'. The layout is designed to read as complete without them.
TO ACTIVATE, add real entries and rebuild. Rules that are not negotiable:
• Only genuinely received, unincentivised reviews. Do not edit them beyond truncation.
• testimonials[] populating is what switches the testimonial section AND its Review/AggregateRating
schema on. Until then no rating markup is emitted at all.
• credentials[] is for certifications that exist and can be produced on request.
• stats[] is for counts that are true and countable (jobs completed, years operating).
• team[] is for real named people who work here.
The FTC Consumer Review Rule carries penalties up to $53,088 per violation for fabricated reviews.
See HANDOFF.md → 'Dormant proof slots' and /leave-a-review/ for the collection kit.
